notes.title: Hack 'n' Stack at Montreal Comiccon + Unity Dev Day Highlights
notes.notes: [p]What an incredible month it’s been for the [i]Hack 'n' Stack[/i] team! 🌟 We had the amazing opportunity to showcase our game at [b]Montreal Comiccon 2025[/b], and the experience was nothing short of inspiring. From the moment the doors opened, we were greeted by a steady stream of passionate gamers, curious developers, and enthusiastic families. 💬🎉 It was heartwarming to see so many people genuinely excited about [i]Hack 'n' Stack[/i] — asking questions, trying out the game, and sharing their feedback. 💖[/p][p]One of the most rewarding parts of the event was seeing players of all ages engage with the game’s mechanics and laugh together as they stacked, hacked, and strategized their way through the levels. 🧱⚔️ The positive reactions and encouragement we received gave us a huge boost of motivation as we continue development 🚀.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366533/65fe227cbbb52ca0d2ee3bef72122f09a8cf69f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Behind the scenes, our team is hard at work on two major fronts: [b]completing the core game loop[/b] 🔄 and [b]developing the online multiplayer mode[/b] 🌐. These are big milestones for us, and we’re excited about the progress we’re making. We can’t wait to share more soon 👀.[/p][p][/p][p]Another highlight this month was our very own [b]Alexandre Gareau[/b] presenting [i]Hack 'n' Stack[/i] at [b]Unity Dev Day Montreal[/b]. His talk focused on our use of Unity’s [b]Data-Oriented Technology Stack (DOTS)[/b] and how it’s helping us build a performant and scalable game. It was a proud moment for the team to see our technical approach recognized and discussed among fellow developers 👏.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366533/ff8c76fc7ee610ecc9f339d4e53978e1674bc644.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🙏 A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by our booth, played the game, or attended Alexandre’s talk. Your support means the world to us 💛. Stay tuned — more exciting updates are on the way! 🎊[/p]

notes.title: Online Mode Development for the First Level 🌐
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]We are actively working on optimizing the online mode for the first level of our game. This level is currently in development, and we are ensuring that the multiplayer experience is smooth and responsive from the very first seconds of gameplay! [/p][p]💡 [b]Challenges of Online Development:[/b] [/p][p] Creating an online level comes with many technical challenges. We need to ensure a stable connection between players, synchronize their actions in real time, manage ping variations, and prevent desynchronization that could affect the gaming experience. [/p][p]🕹️ [b]Minimal Latency, Maximum Fluidity:[/b] [/p][p] We are doing everything we can to reduce response time between players and provide a responsive gameplay experience. Every action should be immediate, with no frustrating lag. [/p][p]🔗 [b]Perfect Synchronization:[/b] [/p][p] We are fine-tuning communication systems between clients and servers to ensure seamless interactions with no delays. This requires precise adjustments so that every movement, attack, or interaction feels smooth for all players. [/p][p]🛠️ [b]Time and Effort Required:[/b] [/p][p] Developing a high-performance multiplayer mode takes time and extensive testing. We spend hours simulating various network conditions, optimizing code to minimize data exchanges, and fixing bugs related to online interactions. Every detail matters in delivering an immersive and fluid gaming experience. [/p][p]We can't wait to share this first stage of the game with you at its best connectivity! Stay tuned for upcoming updates. Thank you for your patience and support! 🎮🔥 [/p]

notes.title: Hack 'n' Stack : A new era begins !
notes.notes:
Newsletter #1 – May 2025 

[b]🧠 It Wasn’t a Mandela Effect… [/b]

Some of you had already noticed it for a while, and we can finally confirm it officially: 
The Tower is now Hack 'n' Stack! 🎉 

This name change also marks a shift in our vision for the game. 
More than just a rebrand, it’s a complete rethinking of the experience we want to deliver. 

[b]🔄 A Shift in Paradigm [/b]

The feedback we received on The Tower prototype was incredibly valuable. 
It helped us identify several limitations in our original approach—especially around pacing, readability, and player freedom. 

The initial concept was simple: 
🧱 Build and repair a tower using eclectic blocks, while defending it from increasingly intense waves of enemies. Players could use anything they found to fight back (and yes, we kept that part!). 

But despite the intensity of the combat, the gameplay felt too restricted and linear. 
The action took place in tight spaces, designed to accommodate the constraints of the in-game camera. 
This technical choice, while practical at first, ended up hurting the overall experience: 

📉 Reduced visual clarity 
🎮 Repetitive gameplay 
⏱️ Slower pacing, even with fast enemy waves 

This shift in paradigm also revealed how complex it is to design an effective camera system within a game engine. 
Traditional solutions no longer worked—we had to experiment, iterate, and let go of some conventions. 

👉 The result: a new approach that’s more open, more fluid, and much more aligned with the spirit of creative chaos we want to bring to Hack 'n' Stack. 

We learned a lot from that prototype, and those lessons are now at the heart of the game’s evolution. 

[b]🧱 Embrace the Creative Chaos! [/b]

Since then, the game has evolved significantly. The central tower is gone! 
We’ve reimagined the experience to be more open, more organic, while keeping the joyful messiness we love so much. 

In Hack 'n' Stack, you’ll: 

Gather resources  

Stack improbable objects  

Build wacky defenses  

And most importantly, collaborate to survive the enemy waves 

It’s chaotic—but it’s strategic, fun, and different every time you play. 

[b]🎯 Our Ambition [/b]

We want Hack 'n' Stack to become your go-to game for game nights with friends or family. 
A game that makes you want to gather, laugh, shout, and jump right back in for another round. 


[b]📅 What’s Next? [/b]

We’re super excited to share this new chapter with you. 🙌 
You can expect: 

More content  

More fun  

And of course, plenty of surprises along the way! 

Each month, we’ll send you a development update so you can follow the journey step by step… and count down the days until launch! 

[b]💌 Thank You for Being Part of the Adventure [/b]

Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm mean everything to us. 
Thanks for following the evolution of Hack 'n' Stack — we can’t wait to show you more very soon!

notes.title: We’re Officially Entering Production!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey new and old friends, [/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that Hack 'n' Stack is officially moving into production! This milestone means we’re closer to bringing you, our game ! 

Hack 'n' Stack wasn’t always as you see today. It started as The Tower, a literal tower defense game with a fun twist. While the concept showed potential, we quickly realized it didn’t quite capture the excitement or depth we wanted to deliver. It felt repetitive, and we knew we could do better. 

So, we pivoted. And wow, what a journey .... Hack 'n' Stack became something much more dynamic and creative. This change wasn’t just a decision, it was a commitment to giving you, our players, a game worth your time. 

[b]What This Means for You: [/b]

[list]
[*]We’ve been listening to all your feedback throughout this process. Your support and enthusiasm keep us going, and we’re beyond grateful.  
[*]As production kicks off, we’ll have plenty of opportunities for you to get involved, think beta testing, feedback sessions, and maybe even a chance to shape some of the game’s features! 
[*]Expect regular updates from us with behind-the-scenes looks, development progress, etc. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366533/68e236e0a09d1735bd3979926c0ebbcdb8ef284e.png[/img]

Stay tuned, and let’s build this together (literally)! 🧱
